children: Mahindra Manulife Life Insurance, the 50:50 joint venture between Mahindra Group and Manulife, has appointed Ruchika Malhan Varma as Chief Marketing and Customer Officer (CMCO), as the company looks to build an AI-driven, digitally enabled and customer-centric life insurance business in India.

Varma brings more than 25 years of experience across financial services, media, entertainment, travel and consumer businesses in India and Asia. Her expertise spans brand building, digital transformation, customer experience and business-led marketing.

In her new role, Varma will oversee brand and marketing communications, corporate communications, digital and growth marketing, customer experience, digital experience, partnerships, DEI, sustainability and AI enablement. Her mandate will focus on building a consumer-first franchise.

Suresh Agarwal, MD & CEO, Mahindra Manulife Life Insurance, says, “Ruchika’s experience at the intersection of brand, customer, technology and business makes her an important addition as we set out to build Mahindra Manulife Insurance. Our ambition is to create an AI-first, consumer-driven insurance company that understands customers better, designs simple and effective experiences and delivers relevant protection solutions. Her leadership will be instrumental in translating this ambition into a differentiated customer proposition and a strong, trusted brand.”

Varma adds, “Insurance is entering a new era where AI, data and deep consumer understanding can fundamentally reshape how customers discover, buy and experience insurance. I am excited to be part of the journey of building Mahindra Manulife Life Insurance as an AI-first, consumer-driven organisation that combines technology and human insight to make insurance more relevant, intuitive and accessible for customers across India.”

Before joining Mahindra Manulife, Varma was Chief Marketing, Customer and Impact Officer at Generali Central Insurance. She led brand and marketing communications, digital marketing, corporate communications, product strategy and innovation, customer experience, digital acquisition, web sales and telesales, along with the organisation’s CSR, DEI and sustainability agendas.
Earlier, as CMO at IDFC FIRST Bank, Varma played a key role in building and strengthening the IDFC Bank and IDFC FIRST Bank brands.
Her career also includes leadership roles at BBC Worldwide, Lonely Planet, Singapore Tourism Board, VIP Luggage and Electrolux.
Varma’s appointment comes as Mahindra Manulife Life Insurance looks to combine technology, data and customer insight to build a differentiated proposition in India’s evolving life insurance market.
